critique: Exact positive inference is proved only for the Gaussian invariant-innovation class constructed around the completion fiber; transfer to the broader Bystrova–Devijver class is converse-only. The Fell boundary law remains conditional on tangent-cone regularity rather than deriving that property from the semialgebraic branch geometry. The bounded-class minimax upper bound follows from the deterministic coefficient-range diameter, gives no sample-size contraction, and does not determine the minimax value or an optimizer. The framing accurately discloses these limitations, so there is no stale claim of exact minimaxity, computational feasibility, or positive inference over the full anchor class.
